subject.title: Reduce gap between multiple providers in menu bar

question: Should CodexBar add a third menu-bar mode containing multiple provider glyphs in one compact status item, with the whole group opening the existing merged menu?
rationale: Current main deliberately supports two presentation models, while this request introduces a third whose interaction contract and maintenance cost cannot be selected from source evidence alone.

options.title: Grouped item, merged menu
options.body: Add one compact multi-glyph status item that reuses the existing merged menu and provider switcher.

options.title: Independent glyph targets
options.body: Give each glyph its own provider menu inside one visual group, accepting considerably greater AppKit and accessibility complexity.

options.title: Keep existing modes
options.body: Retain separate items and Merge Icons only, coordinating compactness work through the related hybrid-mode discussion.

recommendation.title: Grouped item, merged menu
recommendation.body: Add one compact multi-glyph status item that reuses the existing merged menu and provider switcher.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a product-level menu-bar interaction choice, and the repository owner is the clearest available decision owner.
